item.title: Jessica Whistler
item.description: An accomplished Engineering Director with 20 years of experience leading large-scale software and cloud engineering organizations, specializing in AWS architecture, platform engineering, and operational excellence. Proven ability to align technology strategy with business objectives while building high-performing teams, modernizing infrastructure, and delivering secure, scalable cloud solutions across complex enterprise environments. Combines deep cloud expertise with practical adoption of AI-assisted operations, leveraging automation, observability, and intelligent tooling to improve reliability, accelerate delivery, and increase engineering productivity.
